scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ai-exam/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @ai-exam/api" "npm run dev -w @ai-exam/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-exam/types && npm run build -w @ai-exam/api && npm run build -w @ai-exam/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ai-exam/api && npm run lint -w @ai-exam/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test -w @ai-exam/api && npm run test -w @ai-exam/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ai-exam/types && npm run typecheck -w @ai-exam/api && npm run typecheck -w @ai-exam/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:deploy -w @ai-exam/api && npm run prisma:seed -w @ai-exam/api
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @ai-exam/types && npm run prisma:generate -w @ai-exam/api
